precepts.text: A great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns. It said red because Genesis 25:25, regarding Esau, said the first came out red all over like an hairy garment. This red dragon represents the nation or kingdoms of Esau.
precepts.point: He shall also stand up against the prince of princes: the prince of princes is Christ. But he shall be broken without hand: Christ going to destroy him.
precepts.why:
“in the latter time of their kingdom” means the last days, and “their kingdom” is the Edomite kingdoms. Verse 21 speaks of Grecia, and the Greeks were the Edomites at first: yes, they were Japheth, but Alexander and his father Philip were Edomites, and they took over everything.

John saw the same kingdoms: “behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads.” Why red? Because of Esau: “And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.” This red dragon represents the nation, the kingdoms, of Esau.

That is the power behind the king of fierce countenance. “his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power”: the dragon, Satan, gives them their power, and the dragon is painted red because it is ruling through Esau's kingdoms. A king of fierce countenance “understanding dark sentences” goes into religion, into the Bible; what stands up in the last days is a religious system, and it is the kingdom of the red dragon.

precepts.text: The same beast: seven heads, you had Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia, and Great Britain. Ten horns: Belgium, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Germany, United Kingdom, Italy, Greece, France, Denmark, and Ireland. And the dragon gave him his power: the dragon, which is Satan, gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.
precepts.point: He shall also stand up against the prince of princes: the prince of princes is Christ. But he shall be broken without hand: Christ going to destroy him.
precepts.why:
John “saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.” It is the same beast as the red dragon. The seven heads are Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia and Great Britain. The ten horns are Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Germany, the United Kingdom, Italy, Greece, France, Denmark and Ireland.

“and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.” The dragon, which is Satan, gave him his power. That is Daniel's king whose “power shall be mighty, but not by his own power”.

A lot of people think the white man was just so smart that he figured things out on his own. No, there are spirits he works with. Candace Owens did a video on how NASA got to the moon, with a lot of satanic worship and child sacrifice, and people said it was conspiracy; she had proof. The father of rocket science, Jack Parsons, was part of the occult religion called Thelema, with Aleister Crowley, and NASA was heavily rooted in people who joined that occult. When he joined it, his understanding was heightened and he figured out rocket fuel and how it could propel into space. The series Strange Angel tells how he basically encountered the devil and figured out rocket science. That is how they got into space: the dragon gave him his power.

So Daniel's king “shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise”, and “by peace shall destroy many”. Today Trump has the Board of Peace, and everybody says how great it is; no, they are destroying nations. But he stands up against the Prince of princes, Christ, and he “shall be broken without hand”: Christ is going to destroy him.

precepts.text: This leopard represents the Greeks. Four wings of a fowl: four major militaries. Four heads: four major generals; Ptolemy took over Egypt, Seleucus Syria, Lysimachus Thrace, Cassander Macedonia. When Revelation 13:2 says like unto a leopard, it was like the Greek Empire; it's not the actual Greek Empire, but it has elements of it. His feet were as the feet of a bear: the Persians and Medes, that was their symbol. His mouth as the mouth of a lion: Babylon.
precepts.point: He shall also stand up against the prince of princes: the prince of princes is Christ. But he shall be broken without hand: Christ going to destroy him.
precepts.why:
“After this I beheld, and lo another, like a leopard, which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl; the beast had also four heads; and dominion was given to it.” This leopard represents the Greeks. The four wings of a fowl are four major militaries. The four heads are the four major generals: Ptolemy took over Egypt, Seleucus Syria, Lysimachus Thrace, and Cassander Macedonia.

That is why Daniel 8:23 says “in the latter time of their kingdom”: it is the kingdom of Grecia carried on into the last days. When Revelation 13:2 says the beast was “like unto a leopard”, it is like the Greek Empire. It is not the actual Greek Empire, but it has elements of it.

The rest of the beast is read the same way from Daniel 7: “his feet were as the feet of a bear” is the Persians and Medes, whose symbol that was, and “his mouth as the mouth of a lion” is Babylon. So the king of fierce countenance who stands up in the latter time carries the marks of all these kingdoms, with the dragon's power behind him.

precepts.text: In the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up. This is the era we're in now. There are people in this administration studying the scriptures from sunup to sundown; they do a diligent search, like Psalms 64:6 says. People must be dependent on the state for everything; they cannot have private property or land of their own; they are to live in high-rise apartments provided as a benefit, because anybody with a couple of acres, his own water supply, and his own food is a threat to a collectivist society. You see BlackRock and Blackstone buying up housing across America, trying to get rid of private homes. It correlates to what happened in Egypt in Genesis 47: give us food, take care of us, and we give up our property and become servants. You don't think that will happen again? precepts.why:
“when money failed in the land of Egypt,” all the Egyptians came to Joseph and said, “Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth.” Listen to that: money failed. What good is money in a time of famine? It is useless. The first year they gave their cattle for bread. The second year there was “not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands,” so they said, “buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh.” “so the land became Pharaoh’s.”

Don't think that can never happen again. The things written aforetime were written for our learning. The Agenda 21 plan is total collectivism: people dependent on the state for everything, no private property or land of their own, housed in high-rise apartments provided as a benefit, because anyone with a couple of acres, his own water and his own food is a threat to it. BlackRock and Blackstone are buying up housing across America and controlling the rents. It is Genesis 47 again: take care of us, and we will give up everything. And as KRS-One said, we never lost our lands, we lost our minds; the intellectuals stay quiet because the paycheck dictates what comes out of the mind.

Daniel shows the hour it is: “And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.” That is the era we are in now. There are people in this administration studying the scriptures, reading from sunup to sundown and taking notes. Psalms 64:6 says it: “they accomplish a diligent search.”

While you struggle to do your four chapters a day, they have made study their job. While the grocery stores move out of our communities and Section 8 is taken away, too many of our people are still playing with adultery and lies. God has no time for that.

precepts.text: The beast was like unto a leopard: attributes of the Greeks. His feet were as the feet of a bear: ancient Persia and Media. His mouth as the mouth of a lion: ancient Babylon. And the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority: Satan gave this man power to rule. Who is that? Starting with the United States of America, followed by Britain, France, Germany, Russia, all these empires today.
precepts.point: He shall also stand up against the Prince of princes: that is how you know it is not talking about Antiochus; he shall stand up against Christ. But he shall be broken without hand: it is not going to be a man's hand that breaks him; God is going to break this man with his power.
precepts.why:
Daniel says of the king of fierce countenance, “his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power”. Revelation 13:2 shows whose power it is: “And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard”. In Daniel 7 the leopard was the Greek symbol, so this last empire has attributes of ancient Greece. “and his feet were as the feet of a bear”: the bear was Persia and Media, so this last kingdom has elements of ancient Persia and Media. “and his mouth as the mouth of a lion”: the lion was Babylon, so this kingdom has attributes of ancient Babylon.

“and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.” That is the part that answers Daniel: Satan gave this man power to reign and to rule, and great authority. Who is that? The white man, starting with the United States of America, followed by Britain, France, Germany, Russia, all these empires today. Satan gave him the insight, just like Balaam, who saw in visions all the way to the last days.

What does a sinner do with power? “For the good are good things created from the beginning: so evil things for sinners.” Water, fire, iron, salt, flour of wheat, honey, milk, the blood of the grape, oil and clothing: “All these things are for good to the godly: so to the sinners they are turned into evil.” They monopolize water and bottle it and make you buy it. They take fire and make a bomb with nuclear fire. They take iron and the gunpowder found in China and make bullets and guns to kill people. They strip the salt white, they do something to the milk, they make liquors from the blood of the grape to get us drunk, and they mix the fabric of our clothing. Everything good, the sinful man, the white man, turns to evil.

So “he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.” We are the mighty and holy people, and we have already been destroyed: look at every corner, every strip club, every other prison, and you will see our people there. His might is Satan's, and that is why he will not be broken by a man's hand: “he shall be broken without hand.” God is going to break this man with his power.

precepts.text: Rejoice ye heavens and ye that dwell in them; woe to the inhabitants of the earth and of the sea, for the devil is come down having great wrath because he knows his time is short. The heavens are the men in dominion, America, Britain, France, Germany, Canada, Australia; the earth is the third world like Africa; the sea is the islands like Haiti, Jamaica, and Puerto Rico. The devil lives in the heavens.
precepts.point: By peace shall destroy many, and he shall stand up against the Prince of princes and be broken without hand. That is Christ, and this is now.
precepts.why:
“And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.” A leader, a system of fierce countenance, which understands dark sentences, scriptural texts, to a degree. John shows the same thing in Revelation 12:12.

“Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them.” That is not the sky; the sky doesn't go woo. It is men living in dominion, in rulership: Edom today, America, Germany, France, Great Britain, Australia, Canada. Those are the heavens, and those that dwell in them.

“Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea!” Woe means destruction. The earth is the third world countries, like the continent of Africa. The sea is the islands: Puerto Rico, Santo Domingo, Haiti, Jamaica, the Melanesian islands. If you do not live in the heavens, if you are beneath them, woe to you.

“for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.” The devil lives in the heavens, and his time is almost up. That is the parallel between what Daniel said and what John said: the king of fierce countenance who stands up in the latter time is the same devil who rules from the heavens with great wrath.

precepts.text: My sword shall be bathed in heaven; it shall come down upon Idumea, the people of my curse. Idumea is the Greek and Roman name for Edom. If Edom were already destroyed, who is Christ coming back to kill?
precepts.point: By peace shall destroy many, and he shall stand up against the Prince of princes and be broken without hand. That is Christ, and this is now.
precepts.why:
Who is in the heaven that is going to rejoice? Isaiah 34:5: “For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.”

Christ's sword shall be bathed in heaven and come down upon heaven. Look up Idumea: pertaining to Edom, the Greek and Roman name for Edom. That is what the heavens are. Edom today is America, Germany, France, Great Britain, Australia, Canada.

Don't let anybody tell you Edom was already destroyed. If he were, then who is Christ coming back to kill here in Isaiah 34? The people of his curse are still standing in the heavens, and that is why Daniel's king of fierce countenance “shall be broken without hand” in the last kingdom.

precepts.text: The beast like a leopard (Greece), feet of a bear (Media-Persia), mouth of a lion (Babylon), and the dragon gave him his power. It was given unto him to make war with the saints and to overcome them, and power over all kindreds. The saints are the twelve tribes, and they overcame us.
precepts.point: By peace shall destroy many, and he shall stand up against the Prince of princes and be broken without hand. That is Christ, and this is now.
precepts.why:
“And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power.” What does that mean? Revelation 13: “And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard”, like the Greeks, “and his feet were as the feet of a bear”, like the Medes and Persians, “and his mouth as the mouth of a lion”, similar to Babylon, “and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.”

Then Daniel says he “shall destroy the mighty and the holy people”: the twelve tribes of Israel. This man destroyed us. Revelation 13:7 says it too: “And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them.” The same man who stands up in the last days made war with the saints, and the saints are the twelve tribes of Israel. They overcame us and destroyed us. “and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations”: he ruled everybody.

precepts.text: Thou shalt serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee in hunger, thirst, nakedness, and want of all things, with a yoke of iron on thy neck, until he have destroyed thee. precepts.point: By peace shall destroy many, and he shall stand up against the Prince of princes and be broken without hand. That is Christ, and this is now.
precepts.why:
Daniel says the king of fierce countenance “shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.” Haven't we been destroyed? We have been destroyed as a people. Watch the wording of Deuteronomy 28:48.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee.” The Lord sent Europe against us; the Lord sent America against us. “in hunger”: for food. “and in thirst”: for water. “and in nakedness”: for clothing. “and in want of all things”: if you want anything, you have to go to your enemies. If you want education, go to your enemies. If you want to learn about God, you have to go to your enemies.

“and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” Here is the part we want: until he have destroyed us. The yokes of iron have been taken off. What does that prove? That we have been destroyed, exactly what Daniel 8:24 says.

And Daniel goes on: “by peace shall destroy many.” Donald Trump calls himself the president of peace and set up a board of peace, yet he has bombed Yemen, Somalia, Iraq, Iran, Syria, Nigeria and Venezuela. We are living in that time right now.

note.label: America At War With Iran: Preparation For Conflict

precepts.text: Rejoice, ye heavens, the sovereign nations; woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea, the other nations and the islands, for the devil is come down having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.
precepts.point: He shall stand up against the Prince of princes, Christ, but he shall be broken without hand, the same stone of Daniel 2. This extension of Rome is going to fall, for Esau is the end of the world.

precepts.text: The sanctuary is dedicated again on the very day the heathen had profaned it, the dedication Daniel's cleansing points to.
precepts.point: The cleansing of the sanctuary goes into Hanukkah, the feast of dedication. That history is recorded in First Maccabees.

note.label: Daniel 8: The Ram and the Goat

precepts.why:
The saint asked “How long shall be the vision concerning the daily sacrifice, and the transgression of desolation, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot?” and the answer was “Unto two thousand and three hundred days; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed.” The cleansing of the sanctuary goes into Hanukkah, the feast of dedication, and that history is recorded in First Maccabees.

“Now on the five and twentieth day of the ninth month, which is called the month Casleu, in the hundred forty and eighth year, they rose up betimes in the morning, And offered sacrifice according to the law upon the new altar of burnt offerings, which they had made.” The daily sacrifice was offered again, according to the law, upon a new altar.

“Look, at what time and what day the heathen had profaned it, even in that was it dedicated with songs, and citherns, and harps, and cymbals.” The sanctuary was dedicated again on the very day the heathen had profaned it. That dedication, on the twenty-fifth day of the month Casleu, is what Daniel's cleansing of the sanctuary points to.

To take peace from the earth. Remember Habakkuk 1:11, then shall his mind change: Esau will make like they love you, it's all good, but then you end up dead. Esau is always planning something; they are always five steps ahead of black people. “And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many:” By peace shall destroy many. Oh, he destroyed many nations by peace: oh, we love you, God loves you, here's some foreign aid, we love you; then you get death. You want to know how you got jacked up and in poverty like that? Your friendly neighborhood white man.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 18: Babylon Is Fallen

precepts.why:
What the Greeks did. “Yea, he magnified himself even to the prince of the host, and by him the daily sacrifice was taken away”: write down that this is Antiochus Epiphanes. “And the place of his sanctuary was cast down”: what we read about at Hanukkah.

“And an host was given him against the daily sacrifice by reason of transgression”: certain wicked Israelites who hated their own people made a covenant with the Greeks, just like in America today. “And it cast down the truth to the ground”: together they cast down God’s laws, and our nationality. “And it practised, and prospered.”

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 18: Babylon Is Fallen

precepts.why: “And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.” God killed him with an incurable disease.

“And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand”: policy is a course or principle of action adopted or proposed by a government, and Babylon is a government. Business shall prosper in his hand. “And he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many.”

This goes back to the Greeks and Romans as well, Esau: they propose peace. Nigeria asked America for help against Boko Haram, and the policy was, accept same-sex marriage if you want our help. In 2016 America dropped 26,171 bombs on seven countries, and then they claim to be establishing peace by instituting democracy, like the police of the world.
